# Static assets

Images referenced by the root `README.md` live here. Add them with these names:

| File | Used for | Suggested size |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `wisco_humanoid_cad.png` | CAD render in the header | ~1200 px tall, transparent background |
| `wisco_humanoid.jpg` | Photo of the robot in the header | ~1200 px tall |
| `wisco_humanoid_sim2sim.gif` | Demo recording in the `## Demo` section | 600–900 px wide, 10–20 s loop |

Until these files exist, GitHub renders the image tags as broken images. Either drop the
files in or delete the corresponding `<img>` line from the README.

Social posts from the team are a good source for the photo and CAD render; ask the team
for the original file rather than reusing a compressed copy.
